title: 6.22.3 Sub-build: A path from a list
description: Six squares in a list, one loop, one number on each. The picture is drawn from the data.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The canvas is empty. The six squares are in the list `path`, but nothing draws them yet.

steps.title: Draw every square
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, write a `for` loop over `path`. Inside it, `fill` a colour and draw `rect(path[i].x - 30, path[i].y - 30, 60, 60, 6)`. Six boxes should appear in a U shape.
hints: `rect` starts at the top-left corner, so the box is moved half its size (30) up and left from the centre.
Loop to `path.length`, not to 6, so the loop always matches the list.

steps.title: Number them
steps.instructions: In the same loop, write the square's number on it: `text(String(i), path[i].x - 5, path[i].y + 6, 16, 'white')`. The numbers run 0 to 5 around the U.
hints: Change one `{ x, y }` in the list and Run again: the picture follows the data.
